title: ISAAC Local Import Bundle v1
description: What `isaac import` produced from one folder or ZIP on a scientist's own machine. NOT an official ISAAC record: it is extraction output and its evidence, which a scientist reviews before anything becomes a draft and then, through `isaac export`, an official record. Contract: docs/local-import-bundle-contract.md. Size and count ceilings are ALSO enforced by isaac_api.local_import.bundle.validate_bundle (string length and total bytes cannot be expressed here).

format_version.description: 1.1.0 adds record_groups, processing_results and exposures (all optional, so a 1.0.0 bundle still validates) and widens the decision, target and question enums. 1.2.0 adds processed_outputs (optional; absent means none were recorded) and extended_context_entry.processed_output_id. A 1.2.0 bundle REQUIRES processed_outputs (possibly empty); a bundle without it keeps its older version. 1.3.0 adds ai_interpretation.field_path and .run_ids and the optional eligibility_rederived and format_upgrades logs (all optional), and eligibility is derived under a larger writable set (context.electrochemistry.potential_setpoint_V). A 1.3.0 bundle also REQUIRES processed_outputs. 1.4.0 adds the set_clock_time_zone experiment decision (and its decision field clock_zone_binding on a confirm), the confirm_clock_time_zone question kind, the optional candidates[].local_clock block and the optional zone / zone_decision_id on a normalization step (all additive); nothing becomes newly writable. A 1.4.0 bundle also REQUIRES processed_outputs. 1.5.0 adds nothing to the bundle's shape; eligibility is derived under a larger writable set (context.electrochemistry.control_mode), as at 1.3.0. A 1.5.0 bundle also REQUIRES processed_outputs. 1.6.0 (DEC-91) adds three capture decisions — keep_apart on the new target kind merge_candidate, select_athena_version on a processing result (its value one of that result's athena_versions[].version_id; the derived athena_result_of_record / athena_result_of_record_basis), and set_not_counter_positions on the experiment (decision field not_counter_positions) — the optional superseded_merge_candidates section, the derived merge-candidate status kept_apart, and a merge decision's combined group (record_group.merged_by_decision); nothing becomes newly writable. A 1.6.0 bundle also REQUIRES processed_outputs.

merge_candidates.description: LOCAL-P's proposals of record groups a scientist may merge with one decision. Suggestions only. A candidate may name one group plus run_keys (a zero-scan export offered to a confirmed group as context). 1.6.0: status is DERIVED kept_apart (with kept_apart_by_decision_id) while a keep_apart decision names the candidate; a kept-apart candidate is not an open merge question, and no group it names is changed.

grouping_questions.description: Experiment-scope questions the grouping step asks (e.g. naming_counter_positions).

processed_outputs.description: 1.2.0: the scientists' own processed outputs, kept OUT of runs[] (rule isaac.processed_output.origin.v0). Optional: a 1.0/1.1 bundle has none recorded.

superseded_record_groups.description: Groups a `bundle group --regroup` replaced while a decision still named them (e.g. defer, approve_calibration on a proposal). Kept so those decisions keep a target; never a record, never counted as holding its runs.

superseded_merge_candidates.description: 1.6.0: merge candidates a `bundle group --regroup` no longer proposes while a decision (keep_apart) still names them. Kept so those decisions keep a target; never an open question.

eligibility_rederived.description: 1.3.0. Values whose eligibility this build re-derived differently from the build that stored it (its writable set grew), kept so a value composed only under the newer build is never composed silently.

decision_id.description: The decision governing the value when it was re-derived.

format_upgrades.description: 1.3.0. Each time a build first wrote (and re-derived) a bundle an older build stored. decisions_before: how many scientist decisions the bundle held then, so an answer given under the old build's wording is told from one given after.

extracted_state.description: The state the PARSER output alone supports. scientist_confirmed and rejected are deliberately absent: only a scientist_decisions entry can produce them.

relative_path.description: Relative to the source root. Never absolute; never a `..` segment.

shares_file_name_with.description: Other runs whose acquisition file has the same name in a different folder (possible duplicate data; see conflicts[] kind same_file_name_different_folders).

reader.description: For a run a GENERIC reader found: which reader, profile and version, and how many statements it kept.

zone.description: 1.4.0 local_clock_to_utc step: the IANA zone a scientist confirmed for the instrument clock.

zone_decision_id.description: 1.4.0 local_clock_to_utc step: the set_clock_time_zone decision that stated the zone.

readings.description: The engine's raw disagreement readings, in order, duplicates kept: the ONE index space chosen_reading_index uses.

explanation.description: What the conversion did (or why there is no value), in words. The not_proposable_reason says only why the value is not proposable to the website.

excluded_scans_total.description: How many scans were not used, when excluded_scans is a window.

local_clock.description: 1.4.0, a timestamps.acquired_start_utc candidate of rule ssrl_xdc_scan_start_v1: the earliest line-2 local clock time of the run's scans, which names no zone. status is re-derived on every save from the latest set_clock_time_zone decision (rule local_clock_to_utc_via_confirmed_zone_v1); an ambiguous or nonexistent local time in that zone gets no value.

processed_output_id.description: Set when the statement was read from a processed output; such an entry never carries a run_id.

source_path.description: The file the reading cites, relative to the imported folder (or ../<name> for a document beside it). Set when the reading came from a findings file; source_refs carries the source_id when the file is one of the bundle's sources.

quote.description: The words the reading rests on, as the reader quoted them from the cited file. Not checked against the file by this build.

strength.description: stated: the file says it; inferred: one written step from what the file says.

field_path.description: 1.3.0. The field a reading-pass finding reads, set when the target does not say it: a system.element or system.edge finding recorded on a record group (the absorber has no record field). A suggestion only; only a set_absorber decision gives the absorber.

run_ids.description: 1.3.0. For a record-group reading from a finding that names runs (applies_to.scope runs): which of the group's runs it named. Absent: the finding is about the whole beamtime.

identity.description: Always. This build authenticates nobody; a name typed at the CLI is a claim.

qc_status.description: processing_result approve only: measurement.qc.status a scientist stated (pinned vocabulary).

qc_evidence.description: The processing result's own QC verdict and metrics the scientist was shown.

approved_files.description: processing approve: the exact files (and hashes) the approval binds to.

positions.description: set_counter_positions: the 1-based filename token positions that are run/acquisition counters.

clock_zone_binding.description: 1.4.0, confirm of a local-clock start-time candidate only: the instrument clock's time zone (and its set_clock_time_zone decision) the confirmation was made under, and the UTC value that zone gave. A candidate whose current zone or value differs is not eligible until confirmed again.

not_counter_positions.description: 1.6.0, set_not_counter_positions only: the 1-based filename token positions a scientist stated are NOT run/acquisition counters. Grouping is unchanged by it; the counter question stops asking about them.

athena_version_provenance.description: 1.6.0, select_athena_version only: the selected version's own identity (project file, Athena group, data hash prefix). Version ids are positional and move when a project file is added or removed; the selection follows this identity, never the number.

condition_violations.description: Recorded conditions the group's members disagree on. A proposed group must have none.

merged_by_decision.description: 1.6.0: present on the ONE group `bundle group --regroup` proposes for a scientist's merge decision (decision_id, merged_group_id, merge_with, decided_by, from_groups, basis_keys_dropped, name_number_positions, statement). Proposed only; a confirm decision makes it a record.

applicability.description: Optional (absent = the protocol applied). not_applicable: the protocol could not be applied to the group, which is an explicit outcome and NOT a QC verdict. reason_code no_scans = the group lists no scan; no_xas_channel = no energy axis or absorption signal could be formed from the scan's columns. what_the_data_states holds literals (source type, reader, the reader's stated layout, scan format, column labels), never an inferred technique. Such a result carries no qc.verdict and no output file, and no decision is accepted on it.

athena_result_of_record.description: Null until a select_athena_version decision names one of athena_versions[].version_id; DERIVED from the latest such decision on every save. Never changes state, QC or outputs.

athena_result_of_record_basis.description: 1.6.0, derived: the select_athena_version decision (decision_id, decided_by, statement) behind athena_result_of_record.

processed_output.description: One of the scientists' own processed outputs (Athena/Demeter XDI), grouped by name stem as the reader groups it. A reference result and evidence: never a run, never a record group.

states.description: What the files' own headers state about themselves, literally, each with its locator. Never a run value.
